column1: # Scope: Lucene104Codec native binary term-vector writer routing; native readers; optional actual Java asserting writer.
# Names and raw binary terms are hex. '-' is empty bytes; null payload is distinct in INPUT_TOKEN.
# Missing and explicit-empty input documents both decode as null vectors; INPUT/FILES/TRACE retain their distinct causes.
# TRACE records phase, layer, operation and details. Native bulk merge may bypass document callbacks; asserting inherited merge does not.
